subject: Validation request for edge-proxy remediation (re-verification window & evidence)
messages:
From: Caroline Brooks <caroline@fastpay.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Li <m.li@edgeproxysec.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: re-verification window for edge-proxy CVE closure

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the edge-proxy remediation. Our security team completed an initial verification of the fixes but would like a short re-test window so we can validate the delta scope and produce an official retest report for FastPay's compliance folder.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a 48-hour retest window next week and share the following evidence prior to the window?
- short remediation change log (code + config commits)
- a test endpoint (staging or isolated) where we can run non-destructive checks
- results from your internal scanner for the affected component

We will run an authenticated scan, a small exploit-proof-of-concept check, and a configuration audit. If everything looks good we'll issue a retest confirmation letter and attach our retest report to the SIG/SOC2 evidence package.

I can run 20–22 Jan (PST) if that works for you. Please confirm owners and any constraints. I attached our standard retest checklist and scope matrix (attachment: fastpay-retest-checklist.pdf).

Thanks,
Caroline Brooks
Security Operations Manager, FastPay
caroline@fastpay.io

---
Attachment: fastpay-retest-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Brooks <caroline@fastpay.io>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: re-verification window for edge-proxy CVE closure

Caroline —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can support a retest window on 21–22 Jan (PST) and will provision an isolated staging endpoint with identical configuration to the affected edge-proxy service.

Action items on our side:
- Dev (cc'd) will push the remediation commits and provide a short change log + commit SHAs.
- I'll create a scoped test token for your authenticated scans and share the staging URL privately.
- Evelyn (security lead) will review the final evidence package before you begin.

Please note: the staging endpoint will be rate-limited and sandboxed — no destructive testing allowed without prior sign-off. If you need additional access we can open a limited window under supervision.

I'll upload the artifacts to a secure DocSend link by EOD 20 Jan. Confirming: retest window scheduled for 2028-01-21 08:00 PST to 2028-01-22 20:00 PST.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Infra Security
Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 23 Jan 2028 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Retest validation: edge-proxy remediation confirmation and attestation

Caroline / Marco —

Thank you for completing the re-verification on 21–22 Jan. We reviewed your retest report (attachment: edge-proxy-retest-report-2028-01-22.pdf) and compared it to our internal evidence. Summary:

- The re-test validated that the specific CVE vector (header-parse sanitization) is no longer exploitable under the scoped tests performed.
- No new critical findings were observed for the staging build.
- Delta: minor informational items noted in both internal and external scans (listed in the scanner JSON). These are tracked under SEC-482 and will be addressed in a follow-up patch.

Action / attestation: Redwood confirms that the remediation described in remediation-change-log.csv was deployed to the staging environment prior to the retest window and that the scoped re-verification was performed by FastPay's testing team. We are attaching our remediation evidence bundle and a short verification letter for your compliance pack.

Attachments included: edge-proxy-retest-report-2028-01-22.pdf, remediation-change-log.csv, scanner-output-2028-01-20.json

If you require an updated formal attestation statement for SOC 2 documentation (signed PDF), we can generate that and route through Legal — please advise.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
